ck_proto_revision_tokens_nonnegative.name: ck_proto_revision_tokens_nonnegative
ck_proto_revision_tokens_nonnegative.value: ("proto_revision"."tokens_in" IS NULL OR "proto_revision"."tokens_in" >= 0) AND ("proto_revision"."tokens_out" IS NULL OR "proto_revision"."tokens_out" >= 0)

ck_proto_revision_axure_attribution.name: ck_proto_revision_axure_attribution
ck_proto_revision_axure_attribution.value:
("proto_revision"."axure_verified" = false AND "proto_revision"."axure_verified_by" IS NULL AND "proto_revision"."axure_verified_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("proto_revision"."axure_verified" = true AND "proto_revision"."axure_verified_by" IS NOT NULL AND "proto_revision"."axure_verified_at" IS NOT NULL)

ck_usage_record_kind_unit_pair.name: ck_usage_record_kind_unit_pair
ck_usage_record_kind_unit_pair.value: CASE "usage_record"."kind" WHEN 'llm_tokens_in' THEN "usage_record"."unit" = 'tokens' WHEN 'llm_tokens_out' THEN "usage_record"."unit" = 'tokens' WHEN 'image_gen' THEN "usage_record"."unit" = 'count' WHEN 'render_seconds' THEN "usage_record"."unit" = 'seconds' WHEN 'publish' THEN "usage_record"."unit" = 'count' END
